paragraphs: Nutanix, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," or "Nutanix") is a hybrid multicloud computing leader, offering organizations a unified software platform for running applications and AI and managing data anywhere. Our vision is to simplify the deployment and operation of the increasingly distributed landscape of apps and data while freeing organizations to focus on business goals. Our mission is to delight customers with an open, secure platform with rich data services that increases their ability to take advantage of new technologies such as cloud native and AI, optimizes how they run their organizations today, and accelerates innovation, efficiency, and growth.

The Nutanix Cloud Platform is designed to enable organizations to build hybrid multicloud infrastructure, providing a consistent cloud operating model with a single platform for running applications and managing data in core data centers, at the edge, and in public clouds, while supporting customer choice across server platforms, storage options, public and managed clouds, and container and virtualization platforms. The Nutanix Cloud Platform supports a wide variety of workloads with varied compute, storage, and network requirements, including business-critical applications, data platforms (including SQL, NoSQL, and vector databases and business intelligence applications), enterprise AI workloads (including machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), general-purpose workloads (including system infrastructure, networking, and security), end-user computing and virtual desktop infrastructure services, and cloud native applications (including modern, containerized applications).

We originally pioneered hyperconverged infrastructure ("HCI") to break down legacy silos by merging compute, storage and networking into a single software-defined data center platform. We continued to innovate and developed Nutanix AHV, our native hypervisor that offers enterprise-grade virtualization and built-in Kubernetes support. To provide our customers with more choice, we further engineered our software solutions to run on a variety of server platforms and with a variety of external storage providers. Most recently, we have extended our software platform support to include external storage from qualified partners. To provide our customers with the flexibility to choose their preferred license levels and durations based on their specific business needs, we reshaped our licensing by completing a transition to a subscription-based business model. In addition to enabling enterprise AI and simplifying hybrid multicloud deployments, we have a further long-term vision to enable developers to build modern container-based applications once and run them anywhere through Project Beacon, our multi-year effort to provide consistent Kubernetes platform management and data-centric platform services across clouds.

Our business is organized into a single operating and reportable segment. We operate a subscription-based business model, meaning one in which our products, including associated support and entitlement arrangements, are sold with a defined duration. For more information, see the section titled "Components of Our Results of Operations" included in Part II, Item 7, as well as Note 2 of Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

The Nutanix Cloud Platform delivers a set of software products, solutions and services to enable our customers to run and manage their private cloud, edge, public cloud, managed cloud, and hybrid multicloud environments. The Nutanix Cloud Platform's scale-out architecture, common operating model across locations, enterprise-grade data services and freedom of infrastructure choice enable organizations to standardize on the Nutanix Cloud Platform as a single cloud platform to run a wide variety of workloads.

Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure (NCI) is a distributed HCI for enterprise IT applications. NCI software combines compute, storage, and networking resources from a cluster of servers into a single logical pool with integrated resiliency, security, performance, and simplified administration. NCI includes the following underlying features and services:

• Nutanix AOS is the scale-out storage technology that makes HCI possible, delivering enterprise-grade capabilities via a highly distributed software architecture that runs on commodity x86 servers. Nutanix AOS includes integrated snapshots, replication, and disaster recovery that can be used with block, file, and object storage and for both virtual machines and containers. AOS can be run on virtual machines such as AHV and in containers such as AWS EKS, enabling customers to leverage AOS storage for both virtualized and containerized applications.

• Nutanix AHV is our enterprise hypervisor—a modern and secure virtualization solution designed to power virtual machines and containers for application and cloud native workloads. It is a core component of NCI.

• Nutanix Data Services for Kubernetes offers enterprise data services such as data protection, recovery, migration, cloning, and copy data management for containerized, modern applications on Kubernetes.
• Flow Network Security is a stateful, distributed firewall providing microsegmentation to secure network traffic between applications.
• Flow Virtual Networking provides software-defined networking with multi-tenant isolation, hybrid cloud networking, self-service provisioning, and IP address preservation.

• Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) enables organizations to run and manage applications across on-premises and multiple public clouds in a consistent manner. NC2 empowers IT operators to place workloads in their clouds of choice with ease of deployment and migration, delivering flexibility and portability across public clouds.

• Nutanix Central provides management of the Nutanix hybrid multicloud environment, providing global visibility and simplified governance through a single console with federated access and seamless navigation across on-premises and public cloud deployments.
• Nutanix Prism is the unified control plane and UI that provides centralized management for end-to-end IT infrastructure management and operations.

If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flows, and prospects could be materially harmed. In addition, the global macroeconomic environment remains uncertain, which may adversely impact our business, operating results, cash flows, and prospects.

Our business and an investment in our securities are subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, and prospects. These risks are discussed more fully below and include, but are not limited to, risks related to:
• our ability to achieve our business plans, vision, and objectives, including our growth and go-to-market strategies, successfully and in a timely manner;
• macroeconomic or geopolitical conditions, industry trends, and technological developments, including disruptions and delays in global supply chains;
• the competitive market, including our competitive position, advantages and ability to compete effectively, and ability to increase our market share;

Nutanix, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," or "Nutanix") is a hybrid multicloud computing leader, offering organizations a unified software platform for running applications and AI and managing data anywhere. Our vision is to simplify the deployment and operation of the increasingly distributed landscape of apps and data while freeing organizations to focus on business goals. Our mission is to delight customers with an open, secure platform with rich data services that increases their ability to take advantage of new technologies such as cloud native and AI, optimizes how they run their organizations today, and accelerates innovation, efficiency, and growth.

The Nutanix Cloud Platform is designed to enable organizations to build hybrid multicloud infrastructure, providing a consistent cloud operating model with a single platform for running applications and managing data in core data centers, at the edge, and in public clouds, while supporting customer choice across server platforms, storage options, public and managed clouds, and container and virtualization platforms. The Nutanix Cloud Platform supports a wide variety of workloads with varied compute, storage, and network requirements, including business-critical applications, data platforms (including SQL, NoSQL, and vector databases and business intelligence applications), enterprise AI workloads (including machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), general-purpose workloads (including system infrastructure, networking, and security), end-user computing and virtual desktop infrastructure services, and cloud native applications (including modern, containerized applications).

We originally pioneered hyperconverged infrastructure ("HCI") to break down legacy silos by merging compute, storage and networking into a single software-defined data center platform. We continued to innovate and developed Nutanix AHV, our native hypervisor that offers enterprise-grade virtualization and built-in Kubernetes support. To provide our customers with more choice, we further engineered our software solutions to run on a variety of server platforms and with a variety of external storage providers, decoupling our software from the underlying hardware and powering a variety of hybrid multi cloud deployments, as part of our previously-completed transition from a hardware company to a software company. Most recently, we have extended our software platform support to include external storage from qualified partners. To provide our customers with the flexibility to choose their preferred license levels and durations based on their specific business needs, we reshaped our licensing by completing a transition to a subscription-based business model. In addition to enabling enterprise AI and simplifying hybrid multicloud deployments, we have a further long-term vision to enable developers to build modern container-based applications once and run them anywhere through Project Beacon, our multi-year effort to provide consistent Kubernetes platform management and data-centric platform services across clouds.

Our business is organized into a single operating and reportable segment. We operate a subscription-based business model, meaning one in which our products, including associated support and entitlement arrangements, are sold with a defined duration.

Our platform typically includes one or more years of support and entitlements, which provides customers with the right to software upgrades and enhancements as well as technical support. Purchases of term-based licenses and software-as-a-service ("SaaS") subscriptions have support and entitlements included within the subscription fees and are not sold separately. Purchases of non-portable software are typically accompanied by the purchase of separate support and entitlements.

We had a broad and diverse base of over 29,000 end customers as of July 31, 2025. We define the number of end customers as the number of end customers for which we have received an order by the last day of the period, excluding partners to which we have sold products for their own demonstration purposes. A single organization or customer may represent multiple end customers for separate divisions, segments, or subsidiaries, and the total number of end customers may contract due to mergers, acquisitions, or other consolidation among existing end customers.

Our solutions are primarily sold through our channel partners or original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") and delivered directly to our end customers. We have end customers across a broad range of industries, such as automotive, consumer goods, education, energy, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, media, public sector, retail, technology, and telecommunications. We also sell to service providers, who utilize our platform to provide a variety of cloud-based services to their customers.

We plan to continue investing in initiatives that support the long-term growth of our business, including the development of our solutions and sales and marketing efforts aimed at capitalizing on market opportunities. Simultaneously, we are focused on improving our operating cash flow through operational efficiencies, including in our go-to-market functions. By maintaining this balance, we believe we can sustain profitable growth.

paragraphs: Nutanix, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," or "Nutanix") 為一間混合多雲計算領導者，提供組織一個統一的軟體平台，用以執行應用程式與人工智慧（AI）並管理資料。我們的願景是簡化應用程式與資料日益分散的部署與運作，並讓組織能專注於業務目標。我們的使命是透過開放、安全的平台與豐富的資料服務，讓客戶能更有效地運用新技術，例如雲端原生與人工智慧，優化其當前的運作方式，並加速創新、效率與成長。

Nutanix Cloud Platform 設計用以協助組織建立混合多雲基礎建設，提供一致的雲端運作模式，透過單一平台執行應用程式並管理資料，包括核心資料中心、邊緣與公共雲端，同時支援客戶在伺服器平台、儲存選項、公共與管理雲端，以及容器與虛擬化平台的選擇。Nutanix Cloud Platform 支援多種工作負載，包括不同計算、儲存與網路需求，包括關鍵業務應用程式、資料平台（包括 SQL、NoSQL 與向量資料庫與商業智慧應用程式）、企業 AI 工作負載（包括機器學習、生成式 AI 與代理式 AI）、一般用途工作負載（包括系統基礎設施、網路與安全）、終端使用者計算與虛擬桌面基礎設施服務，以及雲端原生應用程式（包括現代、容器化應用程式）。

我們最初發明瞭超融合基礎建設（"HCI"），以打破傳統的孤島，將計算、儲存與網路整合為單一的軟體定義資料中心平台。我們持續創新，並開發了 Nutanix AHV，我們的原生虛擬化平台，提供企業級的虛擬化與內建 Kubernetes 支援。為讓客戶有更多選擇，我們進一步設計軟體解決方案，使其能在多種伺服器平台與多種外部儲存供應商上執行。最近，我們已將軟體平台支援擴展至包含合格合作夥伴的外部儲存。為讓客戶能根據其特定業務需求選擇其偏好的授權等級與持續時間，我們重新設計授權模式，完成向訂閱制商業模式的轉換。除了啟動企業 AI 與簡化混合多雲部署，我們還有進一步的長期願景，透過 Project Beacon，讓開發者能一次建立現代容器化應用程式並在任何地方執行，這是我們多年努力的計畫，用以提供一致的 Kubernetes 平台管理與資料導向的平台服務。
我們的業務組織為單一運作與應報告分部。我們運作訂閱制商業模式，意指我們的產品，包括相關的支援與授權安排，是以特定持續時間銷售。如需更多資訊，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第二部分，第 7 項標題為 "我們營運結果組成部分" 的部分，以及包含在第二部分，第 8 項的財務會計摘要與附註的附註 2。
Nutanix Cloud Platform 提供一組軟體產品、解決方案與服務，讓客戶能執行與管理其私有雲、邊緣、公共雲、管理雲與混合多雲環境。Nutanix Cloud Platform 的擴展架構、跨不同地點一致的運作模式、企業級資料服務與基礎建設選擇自由，使組織能標準化使用 Nutanix Cloud Platform 作為單一雲端平台，執行多種工作負載。
Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure (NCI) 是一項用於企業 IT 應用程式的分散式 HCI。NCI 軟體將一羣伺服器的計算、儲存與網路資源整合為單一邏輯池，並內建防護、安全性、效能與簡化管理。NCI 包含以下基礎功能與服務：
• Nutanix AOS 是一種擴展式儲存技術，使 HCI 成為可能，透過高度分散的軟體架構，在一般 x86 伺服器上提供企業級功能。Nutanix AOS 包含內建的快照、備援與災難復原功能，可用於區塊、檔案與物件儲存，並適用於虛擬機器與容器。AOS 可在虛擬機器（如 AHV）與容器（如 AWS EKS）中執行，使客戶能利用 AOS 儲存來支援虛擬化與容器化應用程式。
• Nutanix AHV 是我們的企業級虛擬化平台——一種現代且安全的虛擬化解決方案，用以執行應用程式與雲端原生工作負載的虛擬機器與容器。它是 NCI 的核心零組件。
• Nutanix Data Services for Kubernetes 提供企業級資料服務，例如資料保護、復原、遷移、克隆及資料備份管理，用於 Kubernetes 上的容器化、現代應用程式。
• Flow Network Security 是一種具有狀態的分散式防火牆，提供微分割功能，以確保應用程式之間的網路流量安全。
• Flow Virtual Networking 提供軟體定義網路，具多租戶隔離、混合雲端網路、自服務部署及 IP 位址保留功能。
• Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) 讓組織能夠以一致的方式在內部部署與多個公有雲端上執行與管理應用程式。NC2 讓 IT 管理員能輕鬆地將工作負載部署至所選雲端，並提供跨公有雲端的靈活性與可移植性。
• Nutanix Central 提供 Nutanix 混合多雲端環境的管理，透過單一控制檯提供全球視野與簡化治理，並支援聯邦存取與在內部部署與公有雲端部署之間的順暢導航。
• Nutanix Prism 是統一的控制平面與使用者介面，提供端到端 IT 基礎建設管理與運作的集中化管理。

Nutanix Cloud Platform 設計用以協助組織建立混合多雲基礎建設，提供一致之雲端運作模式，透過單一平台執行應用程式並管理資料於核心資料中心、邊緣與公共雲端，同時支持客戶在伺服器平台、儲存選項、公共與管理雲端，以及容器與虛擬化平台之選擇。Nutanix Cloud Platform 支援多種不同計算、儲存與網路需求之工作負載，包括關鍵業務應用程式、資料平台（包括SQL、NoSQL與向量資料庫與商業智慧應用程式）、企業AI工作負載（包括機器學習、生成式AI與代理式AI）、一般用途工作負載（包括系統基礎設施、網路與安全）、終端使用者計算與虛擬桌面基礎設施服務，以及雲端原生應用程式（包括現代、容器化應用程式）。

我們最初發明超融合基礎建設（"HCI"），以打破傳統的孤島，將計算、儲存與網路整合為單一軟體定義資料中心平台。我們持續創新，並開發了Nutanix AHV，我們的原生虛擬化平台，提供企業級虛擬化與內建Kubernetes支援。為提供客戶更多選擇，我們進一步設計軟體解決方案，使其可在多種伺服器平台與多種外部儲存供應商上執行，將軟體與底層硬體解耦，並支援多種混合多雲部署，作為我們從硬體公司轉型為軟體公司的先前完成轉變之一部分。最近，我們已將軟體平台支援擴展至包含合格合作夥伴之外部儲存。為提供客戶根據其特定業務需求選擇其偏好的授權層級與持續時間之靈活性，我們重新設計授權模式，完成轉型至訂閱制商業模式。除了啟動企業AI與簡化混合多雲部署，我們還有進一步的長期願景，透過Project Beacon，我們的多年計畫，讓開發者能一次建立現代容器化應用程式，並在任何處執行，提供一致的Kubernetes平台管理與資料中心平台服務於雲端。
本公司業務為單一營運及應報告分部。我們採用訂閱制商業模式，意指本公司產品，包括相關支援與授權安排，以具明確使用期限的方式進行銷售。
我們的平台通常包含一年或一年以上的支援與授權，這使客戶擁有軟體升級與增強功能以及技術支援之權利。以期限為基礎的授權與軟體即服務（"SaaS"）訂閱購買，其支援與授權已包含於訂閱費用中，並非單獨銷售。非可攜式軟體的購買通常會同時購買獨立的支援與授權。
截至2025年7月31日，我們擁有廣泛且多元的超過29,000個終端客戶。我們將終端客戶數量定義為在該期間最後一天前已收到訂單的終端客戶數量，不包含我們銷售給用以自行展示用途的合作夥伴。單一機構或客戶可能代表不同部門、分部或子公司之多個終端客戶，且總終端客戶數量可能因現有終端客戶之間的併購或其他合併而減少。
我們的解決方案主要透過我們的通路夥伴或原始設備製造商（"OEMs"）進行銷售，並直接交付至終端客戶。我們的終端客戶產業範圍廣泛，包括汽車、消費性產品、教育、能源、金融服務、醫療、製造、媒體、公部門、零售、科技與電信業。我們也銷售給服務提供者，他們利用我們的平台為其客戶提供多樣化的雲端服務。
我們計畫持續投資於支持我們業務長期成長的方案，包括我們解決方案的開發以及銷售與行銷工作，以把握市場機會。同時，我們致力於透過運營效率提升營運現金流，包括在行銷推廣功能方面。透過維持這種平衡，我們認為可以實現可持續的獲利成長。

本公司有持續虧損的歷史，且可能無法在 GAAP 或非 GAAP 基礎上維持獲利能力。
本公司持續重視成長的策略，可能在短期內不利於實現或維持獲利能力。
不利或不確定的總體經濟或地緣政治條件，或終端客戶減少資訊科技支出，可能對本公司業務、營業收入及獲利能力造成負面影響。
企業資訊科技市場正在快速變革與擴張，本公司預期未來競爭將持續加劇，來自既有競爭對手及新進市場參與者的壓力將增加。
本公司可能無法把握 Broadcom 收購 VMware 及相關產品組合與商業模式變動所帶來的機會。
本公司所處的市場正在快速演進，使預測終端客戶採用率及對本公司解決方案的需求變得困難。
若終端客戶未採用本公司解決方案，將可能對本公司業務成長及營運結果造成負面影響。
本公司支援外部儲存的產品銷售，可能對本公司核心 HCI 產品銷售造成負面影響，並改變客戶購買新行為，進而對本公司營運結果造成負面影響。
我們在過去期間經歷了顯著成長，我們可能無法持續或有效管理任何未來成長。
我們的歷史財務表現，包括營業收入成長，可能無法反映我們未來的表現。
若我們未能成功執行銷售更多雲端服務的計畫，而這些服務是以可分期訂閱方式銷售，我們的營運結果可能受到不利影響。
企業資訊科技基礎建設技術的發展或改進，可能對我們解決方案的需求造成重大且不利的影響。
投資我們的AI能力會帶來風險，若這些風險實現，可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們的營運結果與關鍵財務及績效指標可能出現顯著波動，這可能使我們未來的結果難以預測，也可能導致營運結果低於預期。
由於我們的營業收入有相當大一部分是在合約服務期間內按比例認列，因此銷售的高低起伏不會立即完全反映在我們的營運結果中。
paragraphs: 您應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告表10-K中所有其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及相關附註，再做是否投資本公司證券的決定。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨的唯一風險；我們可能還會面臨其他我們未察覺，或目前認為不具重大影響的風險與不確定性，這些也可能成為影響我們業務的重要因素。若任何下列風險發生，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及前景造成重大損害。在此情況下，本公司證券的價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。此外，全球總體經濟環境仍不確定，這可能會對我們的業務、營運成果、現金流及前景產生不利影響。
我們的業務及投資本公司證券均面臨多種風險，包括可能使我們無法達成業務目標，或對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及前景產生不利影響的風險。這些風險在下文有更詳細的說明，包括但不限於以下風險：
• 我們能否成功且及時地達成業務計畫、願景與目標，包括我們的成長與市場進入策略；
• 總體經濟或地緣政治條件、產業趨勢與科技發展，包括全球供應鏈的中斷與延誤；
• 競爭市場，包括我們的競爭地位、優勢與有效競爭能力，以及我們增加市佔率的能力；
